svg.title: ChisaBot architecture
svg.desc: Web, PWA, Electron and Android WebView share the same product interface and HTTPS login gateway. The core owns conversation commands, history, tasks, permissions, approvals and delivery. A separate DSH Host per account runs the model and tool loop and persists model history in its Session volume. Tool callbacks return to the core gateway before reaching the shared cloud computer, account-owned devices or integrations. Cloud browser profiles are per Bot; the current app container shares its computer process and workspace. Devices initiate outbound WSS connections. Product records live in PostgreSQL. The host updater reads spool requests and applies compatible updates without exposing Docker to the app.
